description: Llama API - pay per call, no API key. OpenAI-format chat completions on meta-llama/llama-4-maverick, pinned to DeepInfra for reliability. You sign a fixed price computed from your max_tokens; unused tokens are not refunded. 20s server-side timeout - never charged if it fires; set your client timeout to 30s. Try GET /llm/llama/sample.

max_tokens.description: Max completion tokens, capped at 4096 - also bounds the price ceiling.
